item.title: Opinion | Solar ATAP: Why Malaysian Homeowners Hold the Key to the National Energy Transition
item.description: By – Norazam Nordin Malaysia’s renewable energy strategy is often discussed in terms of mega-projects, grid upgrades and national targets. Yet one of the most important components of the transition is not located at a power station or industrial site. It sits quietly above millions of homes. The Solar ATAP rooftop scheme marks a structural shift in how the country approaches energy generation.
